probe.platform: Linux release test ELF, built separately
probe.binary_selection: From /tmp/borsuk-page-auth-release-build.jsonl require exactly one compiler-artifact with target.name == borsuk, target.kind == [lib], profile.test == true, and executable != null; authenticate executable SHA256. Set BORSUK_AUTH_TEST_BINARY to that path. Do not guess or reuse another revision's ELF.
probe.bounded_invocation: systemd-run --wait --pipe --collect -p CPUQuota=100% -p MemoryMax=256M -p MemorySwapMax=0 -p RuntimeMaxSec=120s -p LimitCPU=30 "$BORSUK_AUTH_TEST_BINARY" --ignored --exact sq8_page_authority::tests::page_auth_backend_release_probe --nocapture --test-threads=1
probe.source_bytes_formula: ((i * 37 + i / 251 + dimensions * 11) % 256) as u8; authentication-only synthetic fixtures, never scored.
probe.measurement: 40 raw records: five blocks x four classes x two complete verifier calls repeated ceil(32MiB/payload_bytes) times. black_box function/input/result, rustix ProcessCPUTime and std Instant. Fixture authentication and identities outside measured blocks.
probe.report: One compact strict JSON object emitted by ignored test to stdout amid libtest harness lines; geometry, object/manifest/sidecar/page/payload hashes, all planned blocks including incomplete calls, order, bytes, process CPU, wall, summaries, status. Root must extract exactly one matching schema object and reject missing/duplicate/truncated/nonfinite records.
probe.screen: Weighted sum of each full class median CPU ns/byte: candidate/control saving >=20%; each full class median paired CPU ratio <=1.05. Tails separate, no weighting. Control verifier failure INVALID (setup before candidate comparison, or timed call); candidate semantic mismatch REJECT. Debug/setup/time/resource failure INVALID. No performance correctness panic.
probe.invalid_policy: Nonzero exit, timeout/SIGXCPU/OOM, missing or incomplete report or unenforced limits is INVALID, never REJECT. Successful libtest exit does not imply a passing performance screen; root must read JSON status.
probe.claims: Warm synthetic verifier only; no cold ANN, real-input admission, or speed claim.
probe.root_external_admission: Root will enforce c7i x86 SHA-NI and AVX512 flags, unset OPENSSL_ia32cap, authenticate selected ELF SHA instructions and hard CPU affinity externally. UNRUN here; no in-probe ISA/affinity or threshold change.
